result.summary: Analysis identified three visual discrepancies involving placeholder content, navigation state, and text layout.

issues.description: The app features generic vector illustrations for food items rather than high-quality photography.
issues.suggestion: Replace these placeholders with actual product images to enhance visual credibility and appeal.

issues.description: The search icon is highlighted in the bottom navigation while the user appears to be on a primary discovery feed.
issues.suggestion: Update the active navigation state to correctly reflect the current screen's functional context.

issues.description: Restaurant titles such as 'Trattoria Piccolo' are truncated in the horizontal scroll list.
issues.suggestion: Refine the typography or container sizing to prevent text clipping of vendor names.
